_note: The start-up questions a new shop answers once. Plain words only. 'need' marks the ones Mila can't work without. Everything else has a sensible default, so a shop can be live in a few minutes.

questions.ask: What do you do, in a few words?
Who should Mila say will call people back?
Which suburbs or areas do you cover?
questions.example: Northern Beaches and the North Shore

questions.ask: What hours do you take jobs?
What are the main jobs you do?
Anything people ask for that you don't do?
Any prices Mila is allowed to say? Leave empty and she never quotes.
Should Mila book jobs into your diary, or just take a message?
What counts as urgent, and what should Mila do?
questions.example: Burst pipes or no water: text me straight away.
questions.default: Take the details and say the owner will call back as soon as possible.

questions.ask: How should Mila answer the phone?
questions.example: Birch and Co Plumbing, this is Mila.
questions.default: {shop_name}, this is Mila. How can I help?

questions.ask: Anything else Mila should know or never say?
